name: Datatrans Payment
tagline: Datatrans payment module provides integration with Datatrans payment gateway for Virto Commerce.

git.lastCommit: cec58f3 2026-07-15 ci: Auto update Github Action workflows

readme.overview: Datatrans payment module provides integration with [Datatrans](https://www.datatrans.ch/en) payment gateway for Virto Commerce. It supports two payment modes:
keyFeatures: Two payment modes: Secure Fields (inline) and Lightbox (popup)
Configurable payment method filtering for Lightbox mode
Full payment lifecycle: authorize, capture, void, refund
UI localization for Lightbox — the popup is rendered in the shopper's current culture via the Datatrans `language` parameter

notes.forAnalyst: Card and local payment methods through Datatrans, common in the Swiss and EU markets.
notes.forArchitect: A Payment adapter with five settings. Regional method coverage is the reason to choose it over a global gateway.
notes.forDeveloper: Method availability differs by market and currency, so store configuration matters more here than in a single-method gateway.
reachForItWhen: This gateway is the one the business has a contract with
A store needs a payment method that gateway offers
Card data must stay out of your own scope
doNotReachForItWhen: You need the payment record — that is the order's payment document
The requirement is a new method type rather than a gateway — extend Payment instead
Two gateways for the same method on one store: choose per store, not per request
